options.aiRecommendPrimary: Let AI suggest the main progression

hints.chapterLength: Start around 2500-3500; you can still adjust per chapter.
hints.estimatedChapterCount: Used as the default range for outline, rhythm and pipeline; still adjustable later.
hints.resourceScore: 0 means just started; 100 means settings, characters and planning are fairly complete.
hints.postGenerationReview: When on, after generating chapter text the system checks AI-flavor risk and produces a revision when feasible.

sections.advancedTitle: Advanced settings for narrative experience and AI collaboration
sections.advancedDescription: These affect generation style and AI automation, but beginners don't need to decide right away.
sections.narrativeDescription: These fields shape how readers feel about the work and directly affect chapter tone, density and pacing.
sections.aiDescription: Sets how you and AI divide work and how far the system may auto-advance.

world.title: Reference world sample
world.description: Only records the initial reference. After creating, do import, generation and sync in the "This book's world" tab.

platformHint: After saving, only affects later planning, text, review and revision; doesn't rewrite existing content.

fields.genreAndModeDescription: The genre base answers "what kind of book is this" (e.g. cultivation, urban, alt-history); the progression mode answers "what keeps the book going and paying off" (e.g. system, invincible, homesteading).
fields.postGenerationReview: Detect and fix AI flavor after generation
